findings.title: D-R28-03's Inference marking of the 30-130 ms EN turn-on delay is not pinned: reverting it to the round 27 text passes every check
findings.contradicts: AGENTS.md section 2.5 (an inference not measured or checked against the datasheet must be labelled as an inference). D-R28-03 (R10_DECISIONS.md) lists the turn-on delay among the figures that rest on an inferred input ('The 30-130 ms turn-on delay is marked as the same model', the C87 0.72-1.27 x factor whose X7R DC-bias loss is inferred, D-R19-10) and states 'Test: test_r23_binding_note_rules_and_pin_table pins each new label and rejects the old Calculation-only forms'. round28_fix_cad.md line 89 says the same.
findings.evidence: Seed F6 (.supervisor/r29_gate/seeds/F6_turnon_label.patch), on a git-archive copy of 09a564e: in m3_design/r10_sch_check.py, the chatter obligation 'reboots the board after a 30-130 ms EN turn-on delay (the same model over C87 0.72-1.27 x).' -> '... EN turn-on delay.', which is exactly the round 27 text (git show 19dd0b5:m3_design/r10_sch_check.py). With the saved note: test_r23_binding_note_rules_and_pin_table OK; K-binding FAIL (stale note). After regenerating the note as r10_build.sh's record step does (r10_sch_check.py --binding-note, rc 0): r10_sch_check (check.sh stage) rc 0, check_r10 --only K-binding OK, test_r23_binding_note_rules_and_pin_table OK, and the whole tools/test_r10_check.py suite on the seed: 268 tests OK (6 skipped). The test pins only 'after a 30-130 ms EN turn-on delay' (tools/test_r10_check.py line 452) and has no negative pin for the unlabelled form. Every other D-R28-03 / -04 label seeded the same way fails the pinned test (seeds B4, C4, E2, F1, F2, F4, F5, F7, F9).
findings.impact: A later generator edit of the chatter obligation can drop the marking and regenerate the binding note with a figure that rests on an inferred input stated as fact (the AGENTS section 2.5 class the round 28 triage promoted to Major as R28-TRI-09), and check.sh passes. D-R28-03's 'pins each new label' is not true for this label. The committed note itself is correct today.
findings.concrete_fix: In test_r23_binding_note_rules_and_pin_table, add 'after a 30-130 ms EN turn-on delay (the same model over C87 0.72-1.27 x)' to the D-R28-03 assertIn list and 'EN turn-on delay. Resume' to its assertNotIn list.

observations: D-R28-01 seed A1 (loaded_pack power back to 5.456 V x (1.46 A + aux_A)): r10_parts --check fails 'stale: parts_budget.json' (rc 1) while the budget is not regenerated; after --budget-only regenerates it (the build does), --check rc 0 and test_r10_parts OK; lines 91-92 move to 5.881014 / 4.388745 V while STATUS / parts_qualification / R10_VALIDATION quote 5.880831 / 4.388491 V. Same class as R26-GATE obs 2 / R28-GATE obs 1: no stated rule binds a budget figure to a check.

D-R28-01 seed A2 (ports_w back to a 1.46 A literal): same pattern; c_camera_radio_gps_on moves 13.0641 -> 13.0572 W and the four-stall fire current 1.278747 -> 1.278789 A; loaded_pack keeps 5.880831 V, so ports_w and loaded_pack silently diverge again. Caught only as a stale budget.

Seed F3 (GAP-5: drop ', and the 1.5 ms covers a 0.74 ms gate-discharge model whose 0.4 V off criterion and hot gate charge are Inference') passes the pinned test; the remaining '(Calculation on allocations: the 0.2 / 0.5 / 1.5 ms need bench tests' still marks the figures as unmeasured allocations, so the reverted text would not state an inference as fact.

Seed F8 (chatter: drop ', and the 5.71 V point is the fire budget's, whose hot Q124 factor is inferred') passes the pinned test; the obligation keeps its pinned 'Calculation / Inference' labels and the C87 inference, so it stays labelled.
Seed C5 (rule 4: drop "against Q120's source at R120.1") passes; the criterion still reads '|VGS| of at least 4.5 V', so the procedure is not made false.

The D-R28-02 negative pin 'reads above 0.9 kOhm both ways' uses 'kOhm' while the generator writes 'kΩ', so it can never match an interim 'kΩ' form; the positive pin catches that form anyway (seed B2 fails).

K-binding by design compares the saved note with the generator's output, so every generator seed passes K-binding once the note is regenerated; the pinned SchematicContract test is the guard (all B / C / D / E / F / G1 seeds).

RA10: a 0.02 mm chamfer (0.028 mm diagonal) on the non-critical BAT_FAULT_N F.Cu (22.175, 69.175) passes with an INFO non-critical micro_segment leftover; two 135-degree bends, so the letter of the 45-degree rule holds, and AGENTS section 3 counts non-critical leftovers without blocking (R28-GATE obs 3 class). On a critical net the same seed fails (RA5 short_segment, RA6 micro_segment).
RA12 / RA13: a square bend made a T with a 0.42 / 0.10 mm stub fails dead_copper; the T exemption of right_angle cannot be used to hide a bend.
P2 (R173 back 0.65 mm without its tracks) also fails route_check dead_copper; the spacing test fails it independently at 0.514 mm.

G3 (PORT_TERMINAL_PINS TXO / RXI swapped in r10_parts.py): the build stops in r10_sch.py ('kilib/m3.kicad_sym PortTerminal differs from r10_parts'); r10_sch_check's PORT_PIN_NAMES is an independent table, so a regenerated library would still fail the pin-name check (not run past r10_sch.py).

coverage_limits: No full tools/check.sh run on any copy (DRC, fab manifest and the other self-test suites were not re-run per seed); seeds were judged by the stage that guards them.
No datasheet re-read: the slew, soft-start and VSD figures were checked only for arithmetic.
The G3 seed was not carried past r10_sch.py (the library copy would also have to be edited).
Right-angle seeds at pads and vias were not repeated this round.
